recommendations.problem: Creating a color scale and changing a chart are different store mutations; chart-only cancel cannot undo a shared-scale preview.
recommendations.proposed_route: Search/highlight makes no write. On explicit field acceptance, hold notifications before any scale creation, resolve/create scale, updateChart, then release. Continuous chart-only edits reuse useChartEdit with explicit commit/cancel boundaries.
recommendations.benefit: One meaningful host checkpoint; no orphan preview scales or wrong cancellation.
costs: Error cleanup and overlapping-edit boundaries must be explicit; scale rollback is not supplied by useChartEdit.
alternatives: Restrict proof to existing scales, but that fails the common first-color case.
Hover preview with staged shared scales is deferred.
recommendations.scope_api_impact: Existing APIs suffice for discrete binding. If an error occurs after creation, restore changed chart keys and remove only a newly created, unreferenced scale before release. Do not replace the whole workspace snapshot or concurrent filters.
missing_evidence: No usage telemetry or user study; no local product/browser execution in this research run.
